use_cases: Displaying feature highlights with images on landing pages
Showcasing service categories with hover-animated image cards
Creating interactive grid layouts for product or plan comparisons
Building image-based navigation sections with smooth hover transitions
Designing responsive card grids for portfolio or gallery sections
ai_summary: A four-card grid component showcasing features with images, headings, and descriptions. Each card features smooth hover animations using Framer Motion, including image scaling and saturation transitions. Built with a responsive grid layout and Tailwind CSS for clean, maintainable styling. Ideal for landing pages, feature showcases, and visual content sections requiring interactive hover effects.
